department: Department of Applied Science and Technology

deadline.value: The 42nd-cycle sessions close 16/11/2026 for a 1 March 2027 start and 15/02/2027 for a 1 June 2027 start. No call for an autumn 2027 start was found, so no Fall 2027 deadline is stated.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the call or this programme page.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided by an Admissions Committee, and the thesis topic and supervisor are agreed only after admission. For thematic scholarships you may contact the named supervisor if needed.
supervisor.quote: An Admissions Committee for each doctoral program, appointed by the Rector, evaluates the applications admitted to the competition | The thesis topic will be agreed upon, after admission, with the Program Coordinator and the Supervisor

also.quote: if necessary, contact the scientific supervisor indicated in the description

funding.value: Scholarships are awarded by ranking after an interview, and the university funds at least 110 PhD scholarships for the 42nd cycle.
funding.quote: Politecnico di Torino makes available, for the 42nd cycle, funding corresponding to a minimum of 110 PhD scholarships

also.quote: contributes to the formation of the final ranking

entry_route.value: A master's (second-level) degree is required. Applicants who do not yet hold it can apply conditionally, and an Indian degree needs an exam average of at least 70/100.
entry_route.quote: A second-level academic degree under the Bologna Process or a Master’s degree that grants access to doctoral studies in the country of origin | INDIA 70/100

also.quote: Those who, by the application deadline (see Art. 9, para. 1), do not yet hold a Level II degree and/or language certification may also participate in the competition

notes: Department of Applied Science and Technology. 8 scholarships in the call.
